nvdastocks

nvdastocks package is used to look at how much growth have changhed in the investment in NVIDIA stocks over the period of 1999-2026, helps someone thinking about investing in NVIDIA answer one question: if I had invested on this date then what would it be worth by this time, and how far would it have fallen along the way?

Installation 

remotes::install_github("ETC5523-2026/etc5523-assignment-4-dhoa0015-svg")

Launch the app 

library(nvdastocks)
run_app()

What’s in the package

  • nvda: daily NVIDIA share prices from 1999 to 2026, with moving averages and volatility
  • investment_path(): the value of an investment, and its fall from peak, over any period
  • run_app(): launches the Shiny app

Data

Adapted from the Kaggle dataset “Nvidia Historical Stock Data” by Muhammad Ibrahim Shahrukh (https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/muhammadishahrukh/nvidia-historical-stock-data?select=nvda_stock_clean.csv), licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. The nvda data in this package is shared under the same licence.
